videos.title: Ran Dongdong takes over the big pit case
videos.overview: The female policewoman Ran Dongdong of Xijiang City shot and killed the hostage-hidden criminal in the small supermarket on Miaoqian Street. Although he was praised, he still had a great impact on Ran Dongdong who shot the real person for the first time. When she returned home, her husband Mudafu had some questions about her shooting of the criminal, which aroused Ran Dongdong's disgust. A murder case occurred in Xijiang City. A fisherman found a female corpse by the river. The police team began to investigate the identity of the victim and named the case "Big Cave Case".

videos.title: Ran Dongdong interrogates Shen Xiaoying
videos.overview: Shao Tianwei returned to the police station after investigating the situation on the night of Mudafu's incident. Mudafu went to the hospital to visit Mu's father that day, and sat on the stool of the hospital and got his pants dirty, but he could not explain why Mudafu came home at midnight, which aroused Ran Dongdong's suspicion. Ran Dongdong and Mudafu visited Mu's father and mother, and found out that Mudafu visited Mudafu that day because Mudafu was admitted to the hospital after being cheated online. Mudafu borrowed 200,000 yuan from female writer Bei Zhen to solve the problem. Mudafu explained the whole story to Ran Dongdong.

videos.title: Wu Wenchao tells about Xia Bingqing's past
videos.overview: Thirteen years ago, Mudafu met Ran Dongdong under the introduction of Ran Bumo. The two fell in love at first sight and got along happily. The two even openly discussed Fang Xiaoyu, a female student who admired Mudafu. Finally, Ran Dongdong asked Fang Xiaoyu to give Mudafu a hundred days of flowers and gave Mudafu to her. Fang Xiaoyu did not persist, and the two got along happily in their marriage. Now thirteen years later, both of them feel that each other has changed. Mudafu feels that Ran Dongdong is no longer gentle, and Ran Dongdong feels that Mudafu is no longer honest.

videos.title: Xia Bingqing advised Shen Xiaoying to divorce
videos.overview: Wu Wenchao continued to tell Ran Dongdong and Shao Tianwei about Xia Bingqing that he knew. After accepting Xu Shanchuan's money, Xia Bingqing brought the fruit knife from his family into the house that Xu Shanchuan rented for her. Xu Shanchuan gave Xia Bingqing a job contract for her parents to show rationalization. She suddenly had a lot of money. Xia Bingqing accepted all this and the conditions for being Xu Shanchuan's lover. Ran Dongdong still had many questions while listening to her story. Wu Wenchao said that Xia Bingqing had never told Wu Wenchao who was the one who raped her.

videos.title: Hong Ange asked Ran Dongdong to meet
videos.overview: After searching for Wu Wenchao, Shen Xiaoying's attitude towards marriage in Wu Wenchao's description aroused Ran Dongdong's curiosity. After get off work, she went to Lianhu Hotel for massage and checked the scheduling records of the massage technician, and continued to investigate her suspicion about Mudafu. She found that Mudafu had not come to the door during the two check-in hours. When she returned home, she asked Mudafu that he still didn't want to say what he did in those two times. Ran Dongdong suspected that Mudafu was dating Bei Zhen, but there was no definite answer.
